releaseNotes: MF5 V1 firmware 0.2.1 — self-recovery hardening: do not mark fader values sent on TX failure / unmounted / DetachedHold / Cooldown; re-probe after Cooldown→Idle so replug TX stall can recover without touching faders. Keeps MIDI-only + runtime recovery + 200 ms post-mount hold + ENTER_BOOTLOADER.
